__readme: Allowlist for scripts/check-visibility-vocab.ts. Every entry needs a justification: WHY the claim is provable there, or the tracking id (FOUND_DEFECTS.md D106b) for its removal. Delete an entry in the same change that fixes its surface — that is what re-arms the guard. Never allowlist a NEW write path that sends the retired 'shared'/'private' spellings to the server. Entries match by file, and by line +/-2 when line is set. An entry that suppresses NOTHING is reported as [STALE] by the checker and must be deleted — a file-level entry blinds the WHOLE file, so a new violation there would never fire. NOTE: D105 is RULED (Arman 2026-07-28) — 'internal' is the correct default and stays; never propose flipping visibility defaults. These surfaces are therefore UNBLOCKED work, not blocked work.

retiredSpelling.justification: Dev-only debug surface that deliberately exercises legacy spellings to inspect server normalization; read-only, never a write path.
